primary_endpoint: Liver fat content at 8 weeks (6 weeks post-treatment).
efficacy_outcome: Liver fat content decreased from 8.38 to 7.72 with H. pylori eradication and from 8.50 to 7.29 with lifestyle modification; between-group p=0.10. Within-group changes were significant (both p<0.01).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 0/20 in the H. pylori eradication group and 0/20 in the no-intervention group; deaths not reported.
